prepared.title: Planning the Spring Glaze Workshop
prepared.text:
Yes, if the demo bowls are bisqued before workshop week 3.
Six small bowls take about one shelf, and the load still has room after the 16 workshop pieces and the test tiles.

The order matters:

- Demo night is two weeks before the workshop, so the bowls have about three weeks to dry and can go into the week 2 bisque firing.
- Glaze them yourself before workshop week 3, so the glaze firing is not delayed.
- Put them on the top shelf and label them, so they are not mixed up with the students' pieces.

If a demo bowl is still damp at the bisque firing, leave it out. A damp piece can crack and damage the pieces next to it.
